## How it was tested

<!-- Which test you wrote first and saw fail, and how you ran the change. -->

- [ ] A failing test was written first, then the code
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass in `app/`
- [ ] A line under `## [Unreleased]` in `app/CHANGELOG.md`, if a user would notice
- [ ] Anything added to a prompt is also in its cache key (`src/jobs/hash.ts`)
- [ ] Commit messages are an imperative sentence plus a body saying why, no prefixes
